```{r}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# ==============================================================================
# gRNA Selection - FAST VERSION
# ==============================================================================
#
# Key optimizations:
#   1. Use Biostrings::vcountPDict for FAST off-target counting
#   2. Pre-filter candidates using seed matching (hash lookup)
#   3. Skip full genome scan when possible
#   4. Parallel processing with mclapply (lower overhead than future)
#
# FIX APPLIED: Corrected genomic coordinate calculation for minus-strand genes
#   in off-target exclusion. Previously, the on-target position was computed as
#   gene_start + abs_pos - 1 for ALL genes, but for minus-strand genes the
#   gene_sequence is reverse-complemented, so position 1 maps to genomic_end.
#   The correct formula for minus-strand genes is: gene_end - abs_pos + 1.
#   Without this fix, on-target sites in minus-strand genes were never excluded
#   from off-target counts, inflating seed_matches and off_target_count.
#
# ==============================================================================

# Load required packages
install_if_missing <- function(pkg, bioc = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    if (bioc) {
      if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages("BiocManager")
      }
      BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE)
    } else {
      install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
    }
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
}

cat("Loading required packages...\n")
install_if_missing("Biostrings", bioc = TRUE)
install_if_missing("GenomicFeatures", bioc = TRUE)
install_if_missing("rtracklayer", bioc = TRUE)
install_if_missing("data.table")
install_if_missing("stringr")
install_if_missing("dplyr")
install_if_missing("parallel")

  "F" = c("TTT", "TTC"), "L" = c("TTA", "TTG", "CTT", "CTC", "CTA", "CTG"),

  "G" = c("GGT", "GGC", "GGA", "GGG"), "*" = c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")

REVERSE_CODON_TABLE <- unlist(lapply(names(CODON_TABLE), function(aa) {
  setNames(rep(aa, length(CODON_TABLE[[aa]])), CODON_TABLE[[aa]])

ensure_cache_dir <- function() {
  if (!dir.exists(GENOME_CACHE_DIR)) dir.create(GENOME_CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}

download_ecoli_genome <- function(force_download = FALSE) {
  ensure_cache_dir()
  cache_file <- file.path(GENOME_CACHE_DIR, "ecoli_BW25113.fasta")
  
  if (!force_download && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cat("Loading cached genome from:", cache_file, "\n")
    return(Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(cache_file))
  }
  
  cat("Downloading E. coli BW25113 genome...\n")
  download.file(ECOLI_BW25113_GENOME_URL, cache_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(cache_file)
}

download_ecoli_annotations <- function(force_download = FALSE) {
  ensure_cache_dir()
  cache_file <- file.path(GENOME_CACHE_DIR, "ecoli_BW25113.gff")
  
  if (!force_download && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cat("Loading cached annotations...\n")
    return(rtracklayer::import(cache_file))
  }
  
  cat("Downloading annotations...\n")
  tryCatch({
    download.file(ECOLI_BW25113_GFF_URL, cache_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
    rtracklayer::import(cache_file)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

extract_gene_sequences <- function(genome, annotations) {
  cds <- annotations[annotations$type == "CDS"]
  if (length(cds) == 0) cds <- annotations[annotations$type == "gene"]
  
  genome_seq <- genome[[1]]
  gene_sequences <- list()
  gene_metadata <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(cds)) {
    feature <- cds[i]
    gene_name <- feature$gene %||% feature$Name %||% feature$locus_tag
    if (is.null(gene_name) || is.na(gene_name)) next
    
    start_pos <- BiocGenerics::start(feature)
    end_pos <- BiocGenerics::end(feature)
    strand <- as.character(BiocGenerics::strand(feature))
    
    seq <- Biostrings::subseq(genome_seq, start_pos, end_pos)
    if (strand == "-") seq <- Biostrings::reverseComplement(seq)
    
    gene_sequences[[gene_name]] <- as.character(seq)
    gene_metadata[[gene_name]] <- list(
      genomic_start = start_pos, genomic_end = end_pos, strand = strand
    )
  }
  
  list(sequences = gene_sequences, metadata = gene_metadata)
}

# Null coalescing operator (handles vectors properly)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || (length(a) == 1 && is.na(a))) b else a

# Codon usage from genome
compute_codon_usage <- function(gene_sequences) {
  cat("Computing codon usage from", length(gene_sequences), "coding sequences...\n")
  
  all_codons <- character(0)
  for (seq in gene_sequences) {
    seq <- toupper(seq)
    n_codons <- nchar(seq) %/% 3
    if (n_codons < 1) next
    starts <- seq(1, n_codons * 3, by = 3)
    ends <- seq(3, n_codons * 3, by = 3)
    codons <- substring(seq, starts, ends)
    all_codons <- c(all_codons, codons)
  }
  
  # Raw counts
  codon_counts <- table(factor(all_codons, levels = names(REVERSE_CODON_TABLE)))
  
  # Convert to relative frequency within each amino acid family
  freq <- numeric(length(codon_counts))
  names(freq) <- names(codon_counts)
  
  for (aa in names(CODON_TABLE)) {
    codons_for_aa <- CODON_TABLE[[aa]]
    aa_total <- sum(codon_counts[codons_for_aa])
    if (aa_total > 0) {
      for (cdn in codons_for_aa) {
        freq[cdn] <- as.numeric(codon_counts[cdn]) / aa_total
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("  Counted", format(length(all_codons), big.mark = ","), "codons\n")
  freq
}

# ==============================================================================
# FAST OFF-TARGET ANALYSIS USING BIOSTRINGS
# ==============================================================================

#' Build optimized PAM index with DNAStringSet for fast matching
build_pam_index_fast <- function(genome_sequence) {
  cat("Building PAM index...\n")
  
  genome_seq <- toupper(genome_sequence)
  genome_length <- nchar(genome_seq)
  
  # Find PAM sites
  fwd_matches <- gregexpr("(?=.GG)", genome_seq, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  rev_matches <- gregexpr("(?=CC.)", genome_seq, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  
  cat("  Forward PAMs:", length(fwd_matches), "\n")
  cat("  Reverse PAMs:", length(rev_matches), "\n")
  
  # Extract protospacers - forward strand
  pam_data <- list()
  
  if (fwd_matches[1] != -1) {
    valid_fwd <- fwd_matches[fwd_matches > 20]
    if (length(valid_fwd) > 0) {
      protos <- substring(genome_seq, valid_fwd - 20, valid_fwd - 1)
      seeds <- substring(protos, 10, 20)
      pam_data[[1]] <- data.table::data.table(
        pam_position = valid_fwd, strand = "+", protospacer = protos, seed = seeds
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Reverse strand
  if (rev_matches[1] != -1) {
    valid_rev <- rev_matches[rev_matches + 22 <= genome_length]
    if (length(valid_rev) > 0) {
      protos_fwd <- substring(genome_seq, valid_rev + 3, valid_rev + 22)
      protos <- sapply(protos_fwd, reverse_complement, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
      seeds <- substring(protos, 10, 20)
      pam_data[[2]] <- data.table::data.table(
        pam_position = valid_rev, strand = "-", protospacer = protos, seed = seeds
      )
    }
  }
  
  pam_index <- data.table::rbindlist(pam_data)
  
  # Create DNAStringSet for FAST matching with Biostrings
  cat("  Creating DNAStringSet for fast matching...\n")
  proto_dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(pam_index$protospacer)
  
  # Build seed hash for quick lookups
  cat("  Building seed index...\n")
  seed_index <- new.env(hash = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pam_index))) {
    seed <- pam_index$seed[i]
    pos <- pam_index$pam_position[i]
    if (exists(seed, envir = seed_index)) {
      seed_index[[seed]] <- c(seed_index[[seed]], pos)
    } else {
      seed_index[[seed]] <- pos
    }
  }
  
  cat("  Total PAM sites:", nrow(pam_index), "\n")
  
  list(
    index = pam_index,
    proto_dna = proto_dna,
    seed_index = seed_index
  )
}

#' FAST off-target counting using Biostrings
#' Uses vcountPattern which is highly optimized C code
count_off_targets_fast <- function(protospacer, pam_data, target_position) {
  protospacer <- toupper(protospacer)
  seed <- substr(protospacer, 10, 20)
  
  pam_index <- pam_data$index
  seed_index <- pam_data$seed_index
  proto_dna <- pam_data$proto_dna
  
  # Quick seed match check (hash lookup - O(1))
  seed_matches <- 0
  if (exists(seed, envir = seed_index)) {
    matching_positions <- seed_index[[seed]]
    seed_matches <- sum(matching_positions != target_position)
  }
  
  # Use Biostrings for fast approximate matching
  # vcountPattern counts matches with up to max.mismatch mismatches
  query <- Biostrings::DNAString(protospacer)
  
  # Count matches with 1-4 mismatches (excluding exact matches)
  # This is MUCH faster than R loops - uses optimized C code
  off_target_count <- 0
  
  # We need to find sequences with 1-4 mismatches
  # Strategy: count all with <=4 mismatches, subtract exact matches
  matches_le4 <- Biostrings::vcountPattern(
    query, proto_dna, 
    max.mismatch = MAX_MISMATCHES, 
    min.mismatch = 1,
    with.indels = FALSE
  )
  
  # Find which ones matched
  match_indices <- which(matches_le4 > 0)
  
  # Exclude on-target
  if (length(match_indices) > 0) {
    on_target_idx <- which(pam_index$pam_position == target_position)
    match_indices <- setdiff(match_indices, on_target_idx)
    off_target_count <- length(match_indices)
  }
  
  # Determine class
  has_seed_matches <- seed_matches > 0
  has_off_targets <- off_target_count > 0
  
  if (!has_seed_matches && !has_off_targets) {
    off_target_class <- 1
  } else if (!has_seed_matches && has_off_targets) {
    off_target_class <- 2
  } else if (has_seed_matches && !has_off_targets) {
    off_target_class <- 3
  } else {
    off_target_class <- 4
  }
  
  list(
    seed_matches = seed_matches,
    off_target_count = off_target_count,
    off_target_class = off_target_class
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

reverse_complement <- function(seq) {
  complement <- chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", toupper(seq))
  paste(rev(strsplit(complement, "")[[1]]), collapse = "")
}

translate_codon <- function(codon) {
  codon <- toupper(codon)
  if (codon %in% names(REVERSE_CODON_TABLE)) unname(REVERSE_CODON_TABLE[codon]) else NA
}

get_codons_for_aa <- function(aa) {
  aa <- toupper(aa)
  if (aa %in% names(CODON_TABLE)) CODON_TABLE[[aa]] else NULL
}

parse_mutation <- function(mutation_string) {
  pattern <- "^([A-Za-z]+)([A-Z])([0-9]+)([A-Z])$"
  match <- regmatches(mutation_string, regexec(pattern, mutation_string))[[1]]
  
  if (length(match) == 5) {
    list(gene = match[2], wt_aa = match[3], position = as.integer(match[4]),
         mut_aa = match[5], original_string = mutation_string)
  } else NULL
}

calculate_cassette_score <- function(distance, off_target_class, num_substitutions = 5) {
  base_scores <- c(5.0, 4.41, 3.9, 2.0)
  distance_steps <- floor(min(distance, 30) / 3)
  score <- base_scores[off_target_class] - (distance_steps * 0.2)
  
  max(score, 0)
}

generate_silent_pam_mutations <- function(gene_sequence, pam_position, strand, gene_start = 1,
                                           codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ) {
  seq_chars <- strsplit(toupper(gene_sequence), "")[[1]]
  mutations <- list()
  
  if (strand == "+") {
    gg_positions <- c(pam_position + 1, pam_position + 2)
    target_nts <- c("A", "C", "T")
  } else {
    gg_positions <- c(pam_position, pam_position + 1)
    target_nts <- c("A", "G", "T")
  }
  
  for (pos in gg_positions) {
    if (pos < 1 || pos > length(seq_chars)) next
    
    codon_num <- ((pos - gene_start) %/% 3) + 1
    codon_start <- (codon_num - 1) * 3 + gene_start
    codon_pos <- ((pos - gene_start) %% 3) + 1
    
    if (codon_start < 1 || codon_start + 2 > length(seq_chars)) next
    
    original_codon <- paste(seq_chars[codon_start:(codon_start + 2)], collapse = "")
    original_aa <- translate_codon(original_codon)
    if (is.na(original_aa)) next
    
    for (new_nt in target_nts) {
      if (new_nt == seq_chars[pos]) next
      
      new_codon_chars <- seq_chars[codon_start:(codon_start + 2)]
      new_codon_chars[codon_pos] <- new_nt
      new_codon <- paste(new_codon_chars, collapse = "")
      new_aa <- translate_codon(new_codon)
      
      if (!is.na(new_aa) && new_aa == original_aa && new_aa != "*") {
        
        original_freq <- as.numeric(codon_freq[original_codon])
        new_freq <- as.numeric(codon_freq[new_codon])
        freq_diff <- abs(new_freq - original_freq)
        
        mutations[[length(mutations) + 1]] <- list(
          position = pos, original_nt = seq_chars[pos], mutant_nt = new_nt,
          original_codon = original_codon, mutant_codon = new_codon,
          codon_change = paste(original_codon, "->", new_codon), amino_acid = original_aa,
          original_freq = original_freq, new_freq = new_freq, freq_diff = freq_diff
        )
      }
    }
  }
  # Sort by codon usage similarity (smallest freq_diff first)
  if (length(mutations) > 1) {
    freq_diffs <- sapply(mutations, `[[`, "freq_diff")
    mutations <- mutations[order(freq_diffs)]
  }
  mutations
}

# ==============================================================================
# COORDINATE HELPER
# ==============================================================================

#' Convert a gene-local position (within the coding sequence) to a genomic position
#' 
#' For plus-strand genes: genomic_pos = genomic_start + local_pos - 1
#' For minus-strand genes: the coding sequence is the reverse complement of
#'   the genomic region, so position 1 maps to genomic_end:
#'   genomic_pos = genomic_end - local_pos + 1
#'
#' @param local_pos Position within the gene coding sequence (1-based)
#' @param gene_genomic_start Genomic start coordinate (always the lower coordinate)
#' @param gene_genomic_end Genomic end coordinate (always the higher coordinate)
#' @param gene_strand "+" or "-"
#' @return Genomic position on the + strand reference
gene_local_to_genomic <- function(local_pos, gene_genomic_start, gene_genomic_end, gene_strand) {
  if (gene_strand == "-") {
    gene_genomic_end - local_pos -2 + 1
  } else {
    gene_genomic_start + local_pos - 1
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# gRNA DESIGN - FAST VERSION (FIXED)
# ==============================================================================

#' Design gRNA candidates for a mutation
#' 
#' @param gene_sequence Gene coding sequence (already in correct reading frame;
#'   for minus-strand genes this is the reverse complement of the genomic region)
#' @param mutation Parsed mutation object
#' @param gene_genomic_start Genomic start coordinate of the gene (lower coordinate)
#' @param pam_data PAM index data from build_pam_index_fast()
#' @param gene_genomic_end Genomic end coordinate of the gene (higher coordinate).
#'   Required for correct off-target exclusion on minus-strand genes.
#' @param gene_strand "+" or "-". Required for correct coordinate mapping.
design_grna_for_mutation_fast <- function(gene_sequence, mutation, gene_genomic_start = 1,
                                          pam_data = NULL, gene_genomic_end = NULL,
                                          gene_strand = "+", codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ) {
  seq_upper <- toupper(gene_sequence)
  gene_length_bp <- nchar(seq_upper)
  gene_length_aa <- gene_length_bp %/% 3
  
  # If gene_genomic_end not provided, estimate it (works correctly for + strand)
  if (is.null(gene_genomic_end)) {
    gene_genomic_end <- gene_genomic_start + gene_length_bp - 1
  }
  
  codon_start <- (mutation$position - 1) * 3 + 1
  codon_end <- codon_start + 2
  
  if (mutation$position > gene_length_aa) {
    warning("Position exceeds gene length")
    return(list())
  }
  
  original_codon <- substr(seq_upper, codon_start, codon_end)
  mut_codons <- get_codons_for_aa(mutation$mut_aa)
  if (is.null(mut_codons)) return(list())
  
  search_start <- max(1, codon_start - MAX_PAM_DISTANCE - 23)
  search_end <- min(gene_length_bp, codon_end + MAX_PAM_DISTANCE + 3)
  search_region <- substr(seq_upper, search_start, search_end)
  
  candidates <- list()
  
  # Forward PAMs (NGG in gene-local coordinates)
  fwd_matches <- gregexpr("(?=.GG)", search_region, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (fwd_matches[1] != -1) {
    for (rel_pos in fwd_matches) {
      abs_pos <- search_start + rel_pos - 1
      distance <- abs(abs_pos - codon_start)
      
      if (distance <= MAX_PAM_DISTANCE) {
        proto_start <- abs_pos - 20
        proto_end <- abs_pos - 1
        
        if (proto_start >= 1 && proto_end <= gene_length_bp) {
          protospacer <- substr(seq_upper, proto_start, proto_end)
          
          if (nchar(protospacer) == 20) {
            silent_pam_muts <- generate_silent_pam_mutations(seq_upper, abs_pos, "+", 1,
                                                              codon_freq = codon_freq)
            
            if (length(silent_pam_muts) > 0) {
              if (!is.null(pam_data)) {
                # FIX: Use strand-aware coordinate conversion
                target_genomic_pos <- gene_local_to_genomic(
                  abs_pos, gene_genomic_start, gene_genomic_end, gene_strand
                )
                ot_result <- count_off_targets_fast(protospacer, pam_data, target_genomic_pos)
              } else {
                ot_result <- list(off_target_class = 1, seed_matches = 0, off_target_count = 0)
              }
              
              # Only create ONE candidate per PAM (best codon + first silent mutation)
              # This reduces candidates significantly
              score <- calculate_cassette_score(distance, ot_result$off_target_class)
              
              if (score >= MIN_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {
                candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
                  protospacer = protospacer, pam_position = abs_pos, strand = "+",
                  distance = distance, off_target_class = ot_result$off_target_class,
                  seed_matches = ot_result$seed_matches, off_target_count = ot_result$off_target_count,
                  score = score, original_codon = original_codon,
                  mutant_codon = mut_codons[1], pam_mutation = silent_pam_muts[[1]],
                  mutation_position = mutation$position, codon_start = codon_start
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Reverse PAMs (CCN in gene-local coordinates)
  rev_matches <- gregexpr("(?=CC.)", search_region, perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (rev_matches[1] != -1) {
    for (rel_pos in rev_matches) {
      abs_pos <- search_start + rel_pos - 1
      distance <- abs(abs_pos - codon_start)
      
      if (distance <= MAX_PAM_DISTANCE) {
        proto_start <- abs_pos + 3
        proto_end <- abs_pos + 22
        
        if (proto_start >= 1 && proto_end <= gene_length_bp) {
          protospacer <- reverse_complement(substr(seq_upper, proto_start, proto_end))
          
          if (nchar(protospacer) == 20) {
            silent_pam_muts <- generate_silent_pam_mutations(seq_upper, abs_pos, "-", 1,
                                                              codon_freq = codon_freq)
            
            if (length(silent_pam_muts) > 0) {
              if (!is.null(pam_data)) {
                # FIX: Use strand-aware coordinate conversion
                target_genomic_pos <- gene_local_to_genomic(
                  abs_pos, gene_genomic_start, gene_genomic_end, gene_strand
                )
                ot_result <- count_off_targets_fast(protospacer, pam_data, target_genomic_pos)
              } else {
                ot_result <- list(off_target_class = 1, seed_matches = 0, off_target_count = 0)
              }
              
              score <- calculate_cassette_score(distance, ot_result$off_target_class)
              
              if (score >= MIN_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {
                candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
                  protospacer = protospacer, pam_position = abs_pos, strand = "-",
                  distance = distance, off_target_class = ot_result$off_target_class,
                  seed_matches = ot_result$seed_matches, off_target_count = ot_result$off_target_count,
                  score = score, original_codon = original_codon,
                  mutant_codon = mut_codons[1], pam_mutation = silent_pam_muts[[1]],
                  mutation_position = mutation$position, codon_start = codon_start
                )
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Sort by score
  if (length(candidates) > 0) {
    scores <- sapply(candidates, `[[`, "score")
    candidates <- candidates[order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)]
  }
  
  candidates
}

# ==============================================================================
# OLIGO GENERATION
# ==============================================================================

generate_homology_arm <- function(gene_sequence, design, genome_seq = NULL,
                                   gene_genomic_start = NULL, gene_strand = NULL) {
  seq_chars <- strsplit(toupper(gene_sequence), "")[[1]]
  gene_length <- length(seq_chars)
  HOMOLOGY_ARM_LENGTH <- 85
  
  mut_seq_chars <- seq_chars
  codon_start <- design$codon_start
  codon_chars <- strsplit(design$mutant_codon, "")[[1]]
  mut_seq_chars[codon_start:(codon_start + 2)] <- codon_chars
  
  pam_mut <- design$pam_mutation
  mut_seq_chars[pam_mut$position] <- pam_mut$mutant_nt
  
  mut_positions <- c(codon_start, codon_start + 1, codon_start + 2, pam_mut$position)
  edit_center <- round(mean(mut_positions))
  
  half_arm <- HOMOLOGY_ARM_LENGTH %/% 2
  arm_start <- edit_center - half_arm
  arm_end <- arm_start + HOMOLOGY_ARM_LENGTH - 1
  
  if (arm_start < 1) { arm_start <- 1; arm_end <- HOMOLOGY_ARM_LENGTH }
  if (arm_end > gene_length) { arm_end <- gene_length; arm_start <- max(1, arm_end - HOMOLOGY_ARM_LENGTH + 1) }
  
  arm_seq <- paste(mut_seq_chars[arm_start:arm_end], collapse = "")
  
  list(sequence = arm_seq, start = arm_start, end = arm_end,
       length = nchar(arm_seq), edit_center = edit_center)
}

generate_200bp_oligo <- function(design, homology_arm) {
  oligo_sequence <- paste0(SPACER1, homology_arm$sequence, SPACER2,
                           J23119_PROMOTER, design$protospacer, SGRNA_HANDLE)
  list(oligo_sequence = oligo_sequence, length = nchar(oligo_sequence))
}

# ==============================================================================
# MAIN LIBRARY DESIGN - WITH PARALLEL OPTION (FIXED)
# ==============================================================================

#' Design mutation library - FAST version
#' @param mutations Vector of mutation strings
#' @param system Initialized system
#' @param top_n Number of designs per mutation
#' @param n_cores Number of cores (NULL = sequential, which may be faster for small jobs)
design_mutation_library_fast <- function(mutations, system, top_n = 3, n_cores = NULL) {
  
  gene_sequences <- system$gene_sequences
  gene_metadata <- system$gene_metadata
  pam_data <- system$pam_data
  genome_seq <- system$genome_seq
  codon_freq <- system$codon_freq %||% ECOLI_CODON_FREQ
  
  n_mutations <- length(mutations)
  cat("\nProcessing", n_mutations, "mutations\n")
  
  # Worker function
  process_one <- function(mut_str) {
    mutation <- parse_mutation(mut_str)
    if (is.null(mutation)) return(NULL)
    
    gene_seq <- gene_sequences[[mutation$gene]] %||% gene_sequences[[tolower(mutation$gene)]]
    if (is.null(gene_seq)) return(NULL)
    
    gene_meta <- gene_metadata[[mutation$gene]] %||% gene_metadata[[tolower(mutation$gene)]]
    gene_genomic_start <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$genomic_start else 1
    gene_genomic_end   <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$genomic_end else NULL
    gene_strand        <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$strand else "+"
    
    # FIX: Pass gene_genomic_end and gene_strand for correct coordinate mapping
    candidates <- tryCatch(
      design_grna_for_mutation_fast(gene_seq, mutation, gene_genomic_start, pam_data,
                                     gene_genomic_end = gene_genomic_end,
                                     gene_strand = gene_strand,
                                     codon_freq = codon_freq),
      error = function(e) list()
    )
    
    if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    top_candidates <- head(candidates, top_n)
    
    results <- lapply(seq_along(top_candidates), function(i) {
      design <- top_candidates[[i]]
      homology_arm <- generate_homology_arm(gene_seq, design, genome_seq,
                                             gene_meta$genomic_start, gene_meta$strand)
      oligo <- generate_200bp_oligo(design, homology_arm)
      
      data.frame(
        mutation = mut_str, gene = mutation$gene, position = mutation$position,
        wt_aa = mutation$wt_aa, mut_aa = mutation$mut_aa, rank = i,
        score = round(design$score, 3), off_target_class = design$off_target_class,
        seed_matches = design$seed_matches, off_target_count = design$off_target_count,
        pam_distance = design$distance, strand = design$strand,
        protospacer = design$protospacer, original_codon = design$original_codon,
        mutant_codon = design$mutant_codon, pam_mutation = design$pam_mutation$codon_change,
        pam_mutation_freq_diff = design$pam_mutation$freq_diff,
        homology_arm = homology_arm$sequence, oligo_200bp = oligo$oligo_sequence,
        oligo_length = oligo$length, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    
    do.call(rbind, results)
  }
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  
  if (is.null(n_cores) || n_cores == 1) {
    # Sequential with progress
    results <- vector("list", n_mutations)
    for (i in seq_len(n_mutations)) {
      results[[i]] <- process_one(mutations[i])
      if (i %% 100 == 0 || i == n_mutations) {
        cat(sprintf("\r  Progress: %d/%d (%.1f%%)    ", i, n_mutations, 100*i/n_mutations))
      }
    }
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    # Parallel using mclapply (Unix) or parLapply (Windows)
    cat("Using", n_cores, "cores\n")
    
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") {
      results <- parallel::mclapply(mutations, process_one, mc.cores = n_cores)
    } else {
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
      parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("gene_sequences", "gene_metadata", "pam_data", 
                                    "genome_seq", "top_n", "codon_freq"), envir = environment())
      # Export all required functions
      parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("parse_mutation", "design_grna_for_mutation_fast",
                                    "generate_homology_arm", "generate_200bp_oligo",
                                    "count_off_targets_fast", "generate_silent_pam_mutations",
                                    "calculate_cassette_score", "get_codons_for_aa",
                                    "translate_codon", "reverse_complement",
                                    "gene_local_to_genomic",
                                    "CODON_TABLE", "REVERSE_CODON_TABLE", "ECOLI_CODON_FREQ", "MAX_PAM_DISTANCE",
                                    "MIN_SCORE_THRESHOLD", "MAX_MISMATCHES",
                                    "SPACER1", "SPACER2", "J23119_PROMOTER", "SGRNA_HANDLE", "%||%"))
      results <- parallel::parLapply(cl, mutations, process_one)
      parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    }
  }
  
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
  
  valid_results <- results[!sapply(results, is.null)]
  
  cat("\n--- Complete ---\n")
  cat("Time:", round(elapsed, 1), "seconds\n")
  cat("Successful:", length(valid_results), "/", n_mutations, "\n")
  
  if (length(valid_results) > 0) {
    final_df <- do.call(rbind, valid_results)
    cat("Total designs:", nrow(final_df), "\n")
    return(final_df)
  }
  
  data.frame()
}

# ==============================================================================
# SYSTEM INITIALIZATION
# ==============================================================================

initialize_system_fast <- function(genome_file = NULL, force_download = FALSE) {
  cat("\n=== Initializing System (Fast Version) ===\n\n")
  
  genome <- if (!is.null(genome_file)) {
    Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(genome_file)
  } else {
    download_ecoli_genome(force_download)
  }
  
  genome_seq <- as.character(genome[[1]])
  cat("Genome length:", format(nchar(genome_seq), big.mark = ","), "bp\n")
  
  # Build fast PAM index
  pam_data <- build_pam_index_fast(genome_seq)
  
  # Load annotations
  annotations <- download_ecoli_annotations(force_download)
  
  gene_data <- if (!is.null(annotations)) {
    extract_gene_sequences(genome, annotations)
  } else {
    list(sequences = list(), metadata = list())
  }
  
  cat("Genes loaded:", length(gene_data$sequences), "\n")
  
  # Compute genome-specific codon usage
  codon_freq <- if (length(gene_data$sequences) > 0) {
    compute_codon_usage(gene_data$sequences)
  } else {
    ECOLI_CODON_FREQ
  }
  
  cat("\nSystem ready!\n")
  
  list(
    genome = genome,
    genome_seq = genome_seq,
    pam_data = pam_data,
    gene_sequences = gene_data$sequences,
    gene_metadata = gene_data$metadata,
    codon_freq = codon_freq
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# SILENT MUTATION CONTROL GENERATION
# ==============================================================================

#' Calculate GC content of a sequence
calculate_gc_content <- function(seq) {
  seq <- toupper(seq)
  chars <- strsplit(seq, "")[[1]]
  gc_count <- sum(chars %in% c("G", "C"))
  gc_count / length(chars)
}

get_synonymous_changes <- function(codon, codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ) {
  codon <- toupper(codon)
  aa <- translate_codon(codon)
  if (is.na(aa) || aa == "*") return(NULL)
  
  synonymous_codons <- CODON_TABLE[[aa]]
  synonymous_codons <- synonymous_codons[synonymous_codons != codon]
  
  if (length(synonymous_codons) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  original_freq <- codon_freq[codon]
  new_freqs <- codon_freq[synonymous_codons]
  
  df <- data.frame(
    original_codon = codon,
    new_codon = synonymous_codons,
    amino_acid = aa,
    original_gc = calculate_gc_content(codon),
    new_gc = sapply(synonymous_codons, calculate_gc_content),
    original_freq = as.numeric(original_freq),
    new_freq = as.numeric(new_freqs),
    freq_diff = abs(as.numeric(new_freqs) - as.numeric(original_freq)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Sort by smallest frequency difference first
  df <- df[order(df$freq_diff), ]
  df
}

#' Identify candidate silent mutation sites in a gene - FAST version
#' Only samples a few codons per gene instead of checking every one
identify_silent_mutation_sites_fast <- function(gene_name, gene_sequence, gene_metadata = NULL,
                                                 pam_index = NULL, max_codons_per_gene = 5,
                                                 codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ,
                                                 max_freq_diff = 0.10) {
  seq_upper <- toupper(gene_sequence)
  gene_length_bp <- nchar(seq_upper)
  gene_length_aa <- gene_length_bp %/% 3
  
  if (gene_length_aa < 10) return(NULL)  # Skip very short genes
  
  # Sample a few evenly-spaced codons instead of checking all
  # Avoid first and last 10 codons (start/stop region)
  safe_start <- 11
  safe_end <- gene_length_aa - 10
  
  if (safe_end <= safe_start) return(NULL)
  
  # Pick evenly spaced positions
  sampled_positions <- unique(round(seq(safe_start, safe_end, length.out = max_codons_per_gene)))
  
  candidates <- list()
  
  for (aa_pos in sampled_positions) {
    codon_start <- (aa_pos - 1) * 3 + 1
    codon_end <- codon_start + 2
    
    if (codon_end > gene_length_bp) next
    
    codon <- substr(seq_upper, codon_start, codon_end)
    syn_changes <- get_synonymous_changes(codon, codon_freq = codon_freq)
    
    if (is.null(syn_changes) || nrow(syn_changes) == 0) next
    
    # Filter by codon usage similarity
    if (!is.null(max_freq_diff)) {
      syn_changes <- syn_changes[syn_changes$freq_diff <= max_freq_diff, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(syn_changes) == 0) next
    }
    
    # Take the most usage-similar synonymous change (already sorted by freq_diff)
    syn_changes <- syn_changes[1, , drop = FALSE]    
    # Calculate local GC content (±50bp window)
    window_start <- max(1, codon_start - 50)
    window_end <- min(gene_length_bp, codon_end + 50)
    local_seq <- substr(seq_upper, window_start, window_end)
    local_gc <- calculate_gc_content(local_seq)
    
    # Calculate genomic position
    if (!is.null(gene_metadata)) {
      if (gene_metadata$strand == "+") {
        genomic_pos <- gene_metadata$genomic_start + codon_start - 1
      } else {
        genomic_pos <- gene_metadata$genomic_end - codon_end + 1
      }
    } else {
      genomic_pos <- NA
    }
    
    # Quick PAM check - just look in local sequence
    search_start <- max(1, codon_start - MAX_PAM_DISTANCE - 3)
    search_end <- min(gene_length_bp, codon_end + MAX_PAM_DISTANCE + 23)
    search_region <- substr(seq_upper, search_start, search_end)
    has_nearby_pam <- grepl(".GG", search_region) || grepl("CC.", search_region)
    
    if (!has_nearby_pam) next  # Skip if no PAM nearby
    
      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            gene = gene_name,
            aa_position = aa_pos,
            amino_acid = syn_changes$amino_acid[1],
            original_codon = syn_changes$original_codon[1],
            new_codon = syn_changes$new_codon[1],
            codon_gc_change = syn_changes$new_gc[1] - syn_changes$original_gc[1],
            local_gc = local_gc,
            genomic_position = genomic_pos,
            has_nearby_pam = TRUE,
            original_codon_freq = syn_changes$original_freq[1],
            new_codon_freq = syn_changes$new_freq[1],
            codon_freq_diff = syn_changes$freq_diff[1],
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
    }
  
  if (length(candidates) > 0) do.call(rbind, candidates) else NULL
}

#' Generate silent mutation controls uniformly distributed across the genome - FAST
generate_silent_controls <- function(n_controls, system = NULL, gene_sequences = NULL,
                                      gene_metadata = NULL, gc_bins = 5,
                                      min_genes_apart = 5, seed = NULL,
                                      prefer_high_score = TRUE,
                                      codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ,
                                      max_freq_diff = 0.10) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  cat("\n=== Generating Silent Mutation Controls (Fast) ===\n\n")
  
  if (is.null(gene_sequences)) {
    if (!is.null(system) && !is.null(system$gene_sequences)) {
      gene_sequences <- system$gene_sequences
    } else {
      stop("Gene sequences required.")
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(gene_metadata) && !is.null(system)) {
    gene_metadata <- system$gene_metadata
  }
  
  # Calculate how many codons to sample per gene
  # We want ~3x more candidates than needed for good selection
  n_genes <- length(gene_sequences)
  codons_per_gene <- max(3, ceiling((n_controls * 3) / n_genes))
  
  cat("Sampling ~", codons_per_gene, "codons per gene from", n_genes, "genes...\n")
  
  all_candidates <- list()
  gene_names <- names(gene_sequences)
  
  for (i in seq_along(gene_names)) {
    gene_name <- gene_names[i]
    gene_seq <- gene_sequences[[gene_name]]
    gene_meta <- if (!is.null(gene_metadata)) gene_metadata[[gene_name]] else NULL
    
    candidates <- identify_silent_mutation_sites_fast(
      gene_name = gene_name, gene_sequence = gene_seq,
      gene_metadata = gene_meta, max_codons_per_gene = codons_per_gene,
      codon_freq = codon_freq, max_freq_diff = max_freq_diff
    )
    
    if (!is.null(candidates) && nrow(candidates) > 0) {
      candidates$gene_index <- i
      all_candidates[[length(all_candidates) + 1]] <- candidates
    }
    
    if (i %% 1000 == 0) cat("  Processed", i, "/", n_genes, "genes\n")
  }
  
  if (length(all_candidates) == 0) stop("No silent mutation candidates found")
  
  all_candidates_df <- do.call(rbind, all_candidates)
  cat("Found", nrow(all_candidates_df), "candidate silent mutations\n")
  
  # All candidates already have nearby PAMs (filtered in identify function)
  targetable <- all_candidates_df
  
  # Simple selection: sort by genomic position, pick evenly spaced
  if (!all(is.na(targetable$genomic_position))) {
    targetable <- targetable[!is.na(targetable$genomic_position), ]
    targetable <- targetable[order(targetable$genomic_position), ]
  }
  
  # Bin by GC for stratified sampling
  targetable$gc_bin <- cut(targetable$local_gc, breaks = gc_bins, labels = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)
  
  # Simple stratified selection - pick from each GC bin
  selected_indices <- c()
  controls_per_bin <- ceiling(n_controls / gc_bins)
  
  for (gc in 1:gc_bins) {
    gc_subset_idx <- which(targetable$gc_bin == gc)
    if (length(gc_subset_idx) == 0) next
    
    # Evenly space within this bin
    n_to_take <- min(controls_per_bin, length(gc_subset_idx))
    step <- max(1, floor(length(gc_subset_idx) / n_to_take))
    take_idx <- gc_subset_idx[seq(1, length(gc_subset_idx), by = step)[1:n_to_take]]
    
    selected_indices <- c(selected_indices, take_idx)
    if (length(selected_indices) >= n_controls) break
  }
  
  # If not enough, add random ones
  if (length(selected_indices) < n_controls) {
    remaining <- setdiff(1:nrow(targetable), selected_indices)
    n_needed <- min(n_controls - length(selected_indices), length(remaining))
    if (n_needed > 0) {
      selected_indices <- c(selected_indices, sample(remaining, n_needed))
    }
  }
  
  selected <- targetable[selected_indices[1:min(n_controls, length(selected_indices))], ]
  
  # Generate mutation strings
  mutation_strings <- paste0(selected$gene, selected$amino_acid, selected$aa_position, selected$amino_acid)
  selected$mutation_string <- mutation_strings
  selected$codon_change <- paste(selected$original_codon, "->", selected$new_codon)
  
  cat("\n--- Summary ---\n")
  cat("Controls selected:", nrow(selected), "\n")
  cat("Unique genes:", length(unique(selected$gene)), "\n")
  cat("GC range:", round(min(selected$local_gc), 3), "-", round(max(selected$local_gc), 3), "\n")
  if ("codon_freq_diff" %in% names(selected)) {
    cat("Codon freq diff: mean =", round(mean(selected$codon_freq_diff), 3),
        ", max =", round(max(selected$codon_freq_diff), 3), "\n")
  }
  list(mutations = mutation_strings, details = selected)
}

#' Design silent control oligos - FAST version (FIXED)
#' Over-selects candidates to ensure the desired number of successful designs
#' while maintaining uniform genomic distribution
design_silent_control_library_fast <- function(n_controls, system, top_n = 3, seed = NULL, 
                                                oversample_factor = 2.0,
                                                codon_freq = ECOLI_CODON_FREQ,
                                                max_freq_diff = 0.10, ...) {
  
  # Over-select to account for ~30-50% failure rate
  n_to_select <- ceiling(n_controls * oversample_factor)
  
  cat("Targeting", n_controls, "successful controls, selecting", n_to_select, "candidates\n")
  
  controls <- generate_silent_controls(n_controls = n_to_select, system = system, seed = seed,
                                        codon_freq = codon_freq, max_freq_diff = max_freq_diff, ...)
  
  cat("\n=== Designing gRNAs for Silent Controls ===\n\n")
  
  gene_sequences <- system$gene_sequences
  gene_metadata <- system$gene_metadata
  pam_data <- system$pam_data
  genome_seq <- system$genome_seq
  codon_freq <- system$codon_freq %||% ECOLI_CODON_FREQ
  
  # Process ALL candidates first, track which succeeded
  all_results <- list()
  success_flags <- logical(nrow(controls$details))
  n_total <- nrow(controls$details)
  
  for (i in 1:n_total) {
    ctrl <- controls$details[i, ]
    
    if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == n_total) {
      cat(sprintf("\r  Processing: %d/%d candidates    ", i, n_total))
    }
    
    gene_seq <- gene_sequences[[ctrl$gene]] %||% gene_sequences[[tolower(ctrl$gene)]]
    if (is.null(gene_seq)) next
    
    gene_meta <- gene_metadata[[ctrl$gene]] %||% gene_metadata[[tolower(ctrl$gene)]]
    gene_genomic_start <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$genomic_start else 1
    gene_genomic_end   <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$genomic_end else NULL
    gene_strand        <- if (!is.null(gene_meta)) gene_meta$strand else "+"
    
    mutation <- list(
      gene = ctrl$gene,
      wt_aa = ctrl$amino_acid,
      position = ctrl$aa_position,
      mut_aa = ctrl$amino_acid,
      original_string = ctrl$mutation_string
    )
    
    # FIX: Pass gene_genomic_end and gene_strand for correct coordinate mapping
    candidates <- tryCatch(
      design_grna_for_mutation_fast(gene_seq, mutation, gene_genomic_start, pam_data,
                                     gene_genomic_end = gene_genomic_end,
                                     gene_strand = gene_strand,
                                     codon_freq = codon_freq),
      error = function(e) list()
    )
    
    if (length(candidates) == 0) next
    
    # Mark as successful
    success_flags[i] <- TRUE
    
    # Override codon to the specified silent mutation
    for (j in seq_along(candidates)) {
      candidates[[j]]$mutant_codon <- ctrl$new_codon
    }
    
    top_candidates <- head(candidates, top_n)
    
    for (k in seq_along(top_candidates)) {
      design <- top_candidates[[k]]
      
      homology_arm <- generate_homology_arm(gene_seq, design, genome_seq,
                                             gene_meta$genomic_start, gene_meta$strand)
      oligo <- generate_200bp_oligo(design, homology_arm)
      
      result <- data.frame(
        mutation = ctrl$mutation_string,
        gene = ctrl$gene,
        position = ctrl$aa_position,
        wt_aa = ctrl$amino_acid,
        mut_aa = ctrl$amino_acid,
        is_silent_control = TRUE,
        original_codon = ctrl$original_codon,
        new_codon = ctrl$new_codon,
        codon_change = ctrl$codon_change,
        rank = k,
        score = round(design$score, 3),
        off_target_class = design$off_target_class,
        seed_matches = design$seed_matches,
        off_target_count = design$off_target_count,
        pam_distance = design$distance,
        strand = design$strand,
        protospacer = design$protospacer,
        pam_mutation = design$pam_mutation$codon_change,
        pam_mutation_freq_diff = design$pam_mutation$freq_diff,
        local_gc = ctrl$local_gc,
        genomic_position = ctrl$genomic_position,
        homology_arm = homology_arm$sequence,
        oligo_200bp = oligo$oligo_sequence,
        oligo_length = oligo$length,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- result
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  if (length(all_results) == 0) {
    warning("No designs generated")
    return(list(controls = controls, designs = data.frame()))
  }
  
  designs_df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
  n_successful <- sum(success_flags)
  
  cat("\n  Successful designs:", n_successful, "/", n_total, "candidates\n")
  
  # Now select uniformly from successful ones
  if (n_successful > n_controls) {
    cat("  Selecting", n_controls, "uniformly distributed from", n_successful, "successful\n")
    
    # Get successful controls with their genomic positions
    successful_indices <- which(success_flags)
    successful_details <- controls$details[successful_indices, ]
    
    # Sort by genomic position and pick evenly spaced
    if (!all(is.na(successful_details$genomic_position))) {
      order_idx <- order(successful_details$genomic_position)
      successful_details <- successful_details[order_idx, ]
      successful_indices <- successful_indices[order_idx]
    }
    
    # Pick evenly spaced indices to maintain uniform distribution
    step <- n_successful / n_controls
    keep_positions <- round(seq(1, n_successful, by = step))[1:n_controls]
    keep_mutations <- successful_details$mutation_string[keep_positions]
    
    # Filter designs to only keep selected mutations
    designs_df <- designs_df[designs_df$mutation %in% keep_mutations, ]
    controls$details <- controls$details[controls$details$mutation_string %in% keep_mutations, ]
    controls$mutations <- controls$details$mutation_string
  } else if (n_successful < n_controls) {
    warning("Only ", n_successful, " successful designs, fewer than requested ", n_controls)
    # Keep all successful ones
    successful_mutations <- controls$details$mutation_string[success_flags]
    designs_df <- designs_df[designs_df$mutation %in% successful_mutations, ]
    controls$details <- controls$details[success_flags, ]
    controls$mutations <- controls$details$mutation_string
  }
  
  cat("\n--- Design Summary ---\n")
  cat("Total oligo designs:", nrow(designs_df), "\n")
  cat("Successful controls:", length(unique(designs_df$mutation)), "/", n_controls, "requested\n")
  
  # Verify uniform distribution
  if (!all(is.na(controls$details$genomic_position))) {
    positions <- controls$details$genomic_position
    cat("Genomic spread:", format(min(positions), big.mark=","), "-", 
        format(max(positions), big.mark=","), "bp\n")
  }
  
  list(controls = controls, designs = designs_df)
}

#' Generate report for silent controls
generate_silent_control_report <- function(design_result) {
  controls <- design_result$controls
  designs <- design_result$designs
  
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("SILENT CONTROL DESIGN REPORT\n")
  cat("============================================================\n\n")
  
  cat("--- Control Selection ---\n")
  cat("Total controls requested:", nrow(controls$details), "\n")
  cat("Controls with oligo designs:", length(unique(designs$mutation)), "\n")
  cat("Total oligo designs:", nrow(designs), "\n\n")
  
  cat("--- Genomic Distribution ---\n")
  if (!all(is.na(controls$details$genomic_position))) {
    positions <- controls$details$genomic_position
    genome_size <- max(positions, na.rm = TRUE)
    bin_breaks <- seq(0, genome_size, length.out = 11)
    pos_bins <- cut(positions, breaks = bin_breaks, labels = FALSE)
    
    cat("Position distribution across genome (10 bins):\n")
    bin_counts <- table(factor(pos_bins, levels = 1:10))
    for (b in 1:10) {
      bar <- paste(rep("#", bin_counts[b]), collapse = "")
      cat(sprintf("  Bin %2d: %s (%d)\n", b, bar, bin_counts[b]))
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n--- GC Content Distribution ---\n")
  gc_vals <- controls$details$local_gc
  cat(sprintf("  Range: %.1f%% - %.1f%%\n", min(gc_vals)*100, max(gc_vals)*100))
  cat(sprintf("  Mean:  %.1f%% (SD: %.1f%%)\n", mean(gc_vals)*100, sd(gc_vals)*100))
  
  cat("\n--- Codon Usage Similarity ---\n")
  if ("codon_freq_diff" %in% names(controls$details)) {
    fd <- controls$details$codon_freq_diff
    cat(sprintf("  Frequency difference range: %.3f - %.3f\n", min(fd), max(fd)))
    cat(sprintf("  Mean freq difference:       %.3f (SD: %.3f)\n", mean(fd), sd(fd)))
    cat(sprintf("  Controls with freq_diff < 0.05: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
                sum(fd < 0.05), 100 * sum(fd < 0.05) / length(fd)))
    cat(sprintf("  Controls with freq_diff < 0.10: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
                sum(fd < 0.10), 100 * sum(fd < 0.10) / length(fd)))
  }
  cat("\n--- gRNA Design Quality ---\n")
  if (nrow(designs) > 0) {
    cat("Score distribution:\n")
    cat("  Min:", min(designs$score), "\n")
    cat("  Max:", max(designs$score), "\n")
    cat("  Mean:", round(mean(designs$score), 2), "\n")
    
    cat("\nOff-target class distribution:\n")
    for (cls in 1:4) {
      n <- sum(designs$off_target_class == cls)
      pct <- round(100 * n / nrow(designs), 1)
      cat("  Class", cls, ":", n, "(", pct, "%)\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n--- Example Controls (first 10) ---\n")
  for (i in 1:min(10, nrow(controls$details))) {
    ctrl <- controls$details[i, ]
    freq_info <- if ("codon_freq_diff" %in% names(ctrl)) sprintf(" dFreq=%.3f", ctrl$codon_freq_diff) else ""
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %s%d (%s) GC=%.1f%%%s\n",
                ctrl$gene, ctrl$amino_acid, ctrl$aa_position,
                ctrl$codon_change, ctrl$local_gc * 100, freq_info))
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# QUICK TEST
# ==============================================================================

test_speed <- function() {
  cat("\n=== Speed Test ===\n")
  
  system <- initialize_system_fast()
  
  # Test with a few mutations
  test_muts <- c("lrpS125D", "thrBF45A", "metAL60W")
  
  cat("\nTesting with", length(test_muts), "mutations...\n")
  
  time <- system.time({
    results <- design_mutation_library_fast(test_muts, system, top_n = 3)
  })
  
  cat("\nTime per mutation:", round(time["elapsed"] / length(test_muts), 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("Estimated time for 13,000 mutations:", 
      round(time["elapsed"] / length(test_muts) * 13000 / 60, 1), "minutes\n")
  
  results
}
```

```{r}
  mutate(phospho_id = paste0(Gene.Names..primary., Phosphosite))%>%

  mutate(phospho_in_E = paste0(phospho_id,'E'),

  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(Gene.Names..primary., phospho_in_E, phospho_in_D, phospho_out)%>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!Gene.Names..primary.)

# Then use for your full library:
```
